proposals.expected_signal: If the current search region is over-attributing value to propagation, a deliberately over-smoothed LightGCN variant should keep or worsen the very low frozen full-sort NDCG@10 near the prior 0.0337,,
proposals.failure_mode: Effect may be too predictable if the codebase already regularizes or early-stops away most over-smoothing, yielding only a small delta from baseline.
proposals.hypothesis: Increasing graph propagation depth without changing sampling or protocol will not rescue ranking quality on ML-1M here; instead it should expose depth-induced representation collapse and confirm that simple propagation is a weak direction under the frozen evaluation.
